en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded outdoor wave pool with many swimmers in the water and sunbathers under umbrellas along the poolside. Residential‑style buildings and trees stand in the background. At the lower left of the image side the caption reads "Pécs", and at the lower right "Hullámfürdő". The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, a green Hungarian postage stamp commemorating 1848–1948, printed dividing line and address guides, the printer's mark "Klenstuck Budapest Főfotó 270.10K", and the serial number "2833/30. sz."
